text:
Both assistants provided intriguing opening paragraphs for a fictional short story involving a character who wakes up one morning to find that they can time travel. However, when asked to summarize the story with three bullet points using only nouns and adjectives, without verbs, Assistant B followed the user's instructions more accurately. Assistant A used a verb ("Unleashing") in one of the bullet points, while Assistant B's bullet points were all composed of nouns and adjectives.

Based on the better adherence to the user's instructions in the second question, my final verdict is: [[B]]
